inputs.prompt: ONE original heavy reptilian marsh predator, the Gorefen Packlord, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter side view. Keep the hunched four-legged body with dark charcoal crocodile scales, the long crocodile muzzle with ivory teeth and amber eyes, the rust-red reed mane along the head and back, the long curled scaly tail with a red tuft, ragged olive marsh reeds hanging from its harness, tan wraps on all four legs, the huge ivory branching antler trophies mounted on its shoulders and back (not growing from the head), weathered skull trinkets and one round green-bronze shoulder medallion. Exactly four clawed legs and one tail. Preserve the trophies, skulls, medallion and the broad heavy proportions. A heavy, grumbling idle that loops. The ribcage breathes, the neck lifts and the jaws part in a low snarl, the near forepaw flexes its claws and the tail curls, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. All four feet stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame. Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full muzzle, trophies, claws and tail within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, weapons, magic, glow, sound marks, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the trophies stay fixed to the back; do not morph the harness.
